password_warning_text: Use only on a trusted home network.
password_inactive: No admin password has been set yet.
password_too_short: The password must contain at least 10 characters.
password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
audio_restart_hint: Volume changes are fully applied after restarting the player.
content_hint: Media sources are assigned directly to a category.
name_language_hint: The box displays and speaks the name in its configured language.
name: Name
local_library_hint: Uses the local media library scanned by the MuPiBox service.
ui_restart_hint: Display changes are applied live. If the interface stops responding, restart only the touchscreen interface.
backup_hint: The configuration backup contains SQLite settings, navigation, the password hash and playback progress. Media can optionally be included.
restore_warning: Restoring replaces settings and playback progress. A safety backup is created automatically first.
restore_confirm: Settings and playback progress will be replaced by the backup. Continue?
restore_done: Backup restored. Sign in with the password from the backup.
release_hint: Load and install available GitHub releases or return to the previous installation. The database is backed up before switching.
update_warning: Player and interface services restart during an update. Do not power off the box.
no_releases: No GitHub releases are available yet.
update_confirm: The box restarts its services while switching versions. Continue?
update_started: Update started. The interface will reconnect after a few minutes.
no_local_directories: No subfolders were found in the media directory.
resume_hint: Shows the most recently started media that has not been completed. Its name and position are controlled by the category and ordering.
wifi_hint: Scan and connect to networks. MuPiBox does not store the password.
wifi_power_off_warning: The currently used Wi-Fi adapter will be disabled. The connection may briefly drop. Continue?
bluetooth_controls_hint: Media buttons from compatible devices will be mapped to the shared player controls in a subsequent stage.
wifi_password_short: The Wi-Fi password must contain at least 8 characters.
password_guide: Set a dedicated, long password for the admin portal.
network_intro: Adapters, Wi-Fi and IP configuration in one place.
network_guide: DHCP is the most robust choice. Configure a static IPv4 address only when gateway and DNS values are known.
static_ip_notice: The configuration is saved. It is applied automatically only after the network backend is safely supported.
static_ip_networkmanager: Values are saved. Automatic NetworkManager application is enabled after a safe connection test.
static_ip_networkd: Values are saved. Automatic systemd-networkd application follows after the device test.
static_ip_ifupdown: Values are saved. Automatic DietPi/ifupdown application follows after the device test so SSH is not lost accidentally.
static_ip_unknown: The network backend could not be identified safely; nothing is overwritten automatically.
providers_guide: Credentials can be prepared now; Spotify and Amazon Music playback adapters follow separately.
amazon_warning: Amazon Music has no general public playback API. This configuration does not enable playback yet.
mupihat_guide: Incorrect voltage or shutdown values can cause data loss. Use a supplied profile when in doubt.
mupihat_status_hint: Values are stored persistently. The hardware service is connected in the next MuPiHAT step.
mqtt_guide: A native Home Assistant integration using the MuPiBox API is planned. MQTT remains optional for existing brokers and generic automations.
mqtt_status_hint: The configuration is stored; the MQTT publisher is enabled separately once status and control topics are final.
system_intro: Measure the current state, then optimize deliberately.
system_guide: A dedicated audio box usually needs neither swap nor waiting for full network connectivity. Measure first, then change.
swap_impact: Reduces SD-card writes; processes may be terminated sooner when memory is exhausted.
wait_online_impact: Speeds up offline boots. Providers load when the network becomes available.
performance_impact: Performance responds faster but consumes more power and creates more heat.
initial_turbo_impact: Use the highest CPU clock for this many seconds during boot. DietPi recommends 20 seconds; 0 disables it. Takes effect after reboot.
power_controls_hint: Playback is stopped and pending data is written safely.
reboot_confirm: Restart MuPiBox now? The admin connection will be interrupted briefly.
shutdown_confirm: Shut down MuPiBox safely now? It must be powered on again to restart.
system_change_confirm: System options will be applied now. Network and services may be interrupted briefly. Continue?
